_comment: Applied only with `pnpm generate:findings`. Deliberate, labeled weaknesses so a scanner has something real to find. Never deploy these to a real project.

endpoints.title: Broken authentication
endpoints.description: Customer list is reachable with no token; tenant comes from the query string.

endpoints.title: BOLA / IDOR
endpoints.description: Any signed-in user can read any tenant's order by passing ?tenantId=.

endpoints.title: Mass assignment
endpoints.description: PATCH body is written as-is, so callers can set role/tenantId fields.

rules.title: Over-permissive Firestore rule
rules.description: Payments collection readable by anyone with the web config.
